title.narrative: DDF Democracy Development Foundation Armenia - Democratic Integrity 2025-2027
DDF Democracy Development Foundation Armenia - Democratic Integrity 2025-2027

description.narrative:
The project aims to contribute to the following impact: civil society effectively contributes to Armenia's democratic resilience in a period of external and domestic turbulence
The project aims to have strengthened civil society interventions in upholding democratic values and practices (Outcome 1). To this end, the following three Outputs will be pursued:
Improved civil society outreach to citizens to promote democratic practices (Output 1.1). Responsive civil society measures to reduce the spread and impact of government and/or foreign information manipulation campaigns (Output 1.2). Improved civil society monitoring and advocacy to uphold the principles of competitiveness and transparency in the 2026 elections season (Output 1.3).
As for the second phase of the project, it has two designs, depending on the two probable developments in the post-election.
Scenario #1 Enhanced civil society participation in implementing effective democratic reforms (Outcome 2). Coordinated civil society advocacy for implementing Armenia's commitments under Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement and Visa Liberalisation Action Plan (Output 2.1). Continuous civil society support to uphold the rights of vulnerable groups (Output 2.2).
Scenario #2 Enhanced civil society resistance to authoritarian resurgence (Outcome 2). Sustained civic spaces despite government pressure (Output 2.1) Independent media operating amidst the shrinking of civic space (Output 2.2) Functional mechanisms for defending human rights and freedoms for vulnerable groups and human rights defenders (Output 2.3)

"Partnership for Democratic Integrity" aims at civil society effectively contributes to Armenia’s democratic resilience in a period of external and domestic turbulence: 1) Strengthened civil society interventions in upholding democratic values and practices; 2) Enhanced civil society participation in implementing effective democratic reforms / Enhanced civil society resistance to authoritarian resurgence.

"Partnerskap för demokratisk integritet" syftar till att civilsamhället effektivt bidrar till Armeniens demokratiska motståndskraft i en period av extern och inhemsk turbulens: 1) Stärkta civilsamhällesinsatser för att upprätthålla demokratiska värderingar och praxis; 2) Ökat civilsamhällesdeltagande i genomförandet av effektiva demokratiska reformer / Ökat civilsamhälles motstånd mot auktoritär återuppgång.
